designationHistory.indexText: Established on January 18, 2001, by the Secretary of the Interior, combining land bought from The Nature Conservancy with submerged lands and waters out to 12 nautical miles transferred by Secretarial Order.

authority.citation: Secretarial Order transferring jurisdiction from the Office of Insular Affairs; Endangered Species Act and Fish and Wildlife Act authority

designationHistory.note: The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Palmyra Atoll National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, Jan. 24, 2001 (01-1946): notice establishing Palmyra Atoll National Wildlife Refuge; jurisdiction over submerged lands transferred by Secretarial Order, FONSI signed Jan. 17, 2001

review.note: Administrative action by the Secretary of the Interior, not a presidential order; administration Clinton.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in January 18, 2001, by the Secretary of the Interior and included submerged lands and associated waters out to 12 nautical miles from the atoll.
